description: Live FXHUB exchange rates (Tbilisi, Georgia): online exchange by bank transfer and the cash exchange point, each with buy and sell, plus the National Bank of Georgia official rate. Use for questions like "What is FXHUB's dollar rate?" or "FXHUB euro rate today", or to compare FXHUB with the NBG rate or another provider. Leave pair empty for every pair. These are FXHUB's standard rates; for larger amounts FXHUB also gives special (custom or individual) rates on request, explained in the result. For rubles, ask for a RUB pair (RUB/GEL, USD/RUB or EUR/RUB): the answer then covers what FXHUB offers ruble clients.

channel.description: online (bank transfer), cash (exchange point) or all. Default all.

language.description: Language of the text answer: en, ka (Georgian) or ru (Russian), usually the language the user writes in. Default en.

pair.description: Currency pair such as USD/GEL, EUR/USD or RUB/GEL, or one code (USD) for its rate against GEL. Leave empty for all pairs.

name: get_exchange_rates
title: Get FXHUB exchange rates
